content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-33. - Menacing.
content.summary:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person, by threat or physical action, intentionally to
               place another person in fear of imminent bodily injury.
(b)
This section shall not apply in any case where menacing is committed by use of a deadly
               weapon.
(Code 1960, § 17-7; Code 1…
